realm.name: WAREHOUSE_STAFF
realm.description: Update inventory levels, record new stock/goods received, and print shipping labels/packing slips.

realm.name: SUPER_ADMIN
realm.description: Full System Access: Manage personnel (add, edit, or remove other Admins), view overall revenue reports, configure system and payment settings, and handle Keycloak integrations.

realm.name: STORE_MANAGER
realm.description: Manage product catalog, create promotions, approve orders, and oversee inventory. (Cannot add or remove staff).

realm.name: SUPPORT_AGENT
realm.description: View and update order statuses (e.g., Confirmed, Delivered), process returns and exchanges, and view customer information.

realm.name: CUSTOMER
realm.description: Browse products, place orders, manage saved addresses, and view personal order history.
